title: Global in time justification of a two-phase averaged system for heat-conducting ideal gases
summary: In this article, we mathematically justify (globally in time) a Baer-Nunziato type system from the non-isentropic compressible Navier-Sokes equations for heat conducting ideal gases posed over the torus and in one space dimension. The breakthrough in this paper is to define and prove the global existence of solutions in a framework intermediate between weak and strong solutions and then to derive the system through homogenization and Young measures characterization.
